name: Merge PDF, Split & Unlock
tagline: Merge, split, lock, unlock and convert PDFs — entirely on your iPhone.
tracking_detail: The app shows ads from Google AdMob to stay free. If you choose **Allow** in the App Tracking Transparency prompt, Google AdMob may use your device's advertising identifier (IDFA) to personalise ads and measure them across other companies' apps. If you choose **Ask App Not to Track**, the IDFA is not used, ads are not personalised, and every feature keeps working. You can change this at any time in *iOS Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking*. Premium removes ads.
storage_summary: Your documents, the files you create and your history are stored only on your device. All PDF processing happens on your device; your documents are never uploaded.

admob.name: Google AdMob (Google Mobile Ads and User Messaging Platform)
admob.purpose: Shows the ads that keep the app free, measures how they perform, and asks for your ad-privacy choices where the law requires it.
admob.data: your advertising identifier (IDFA) only if you allow tracking, your IP address, device model, OS version, and your interactions with ads (views and taps)

firebase.name: Google Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config)
firebase.purpose: Tells us which tools are used and whether they finish, reports crashes, and delivers app and ad configuration. Usage events never include the names or contents of your documents.
firebase.data: in-app usage events (for example which tool you opened and whether the job finished), device model, OS version, app-generated identifiers and crash logs

data_sent.what: Advertising identifier (IDFA) — only if you allow tracking
IP address, device model, OS version and ad interactions
data_sent.why: Show ads, prevent ad fraud and measure ad performance

data_sent.what: Your ad-privacy choices (where the law requires a consent form)
In-app usage events, device model, OS version and app identifiers — never document names or contents
data_sent.why: Understand which tools are used and improve the app

stored_on_device: The PDFs and images you import, and every file you create — merged, split, compressed, converted, locked or unlocked.
All PDF work — merging, splitting, compressing, converting, locking, unlocking, scanning and text recognition — runs on your device. Your documents are never uploaded.
Passwords you type to lock or unlock a PDF are used on your device to process that file and are never sent anywhere.
**Web to PDF** loads the web page you enter directly from that website, the same way a browser does. We do not receive the address or the page.
Your history, settings and App Lock preference. If you turn on App Lock, Face ID or Touch ID is checked by iOS; the app never receives your biometric data.
Delete files in **History**, or delete the app to remove everything.
not_collected: Your name, email address or any account — the app has no sign-in.
The names or contents of your documents, or the passwords you use to lock or unlock them.
Your photo library — images you import are picked by you with the system photo picker.
Your precise location, contacts or browsing history.

permissions.name: Camera
permissions.why: to scan paper documents into PDFs. Scans stay on your device.

permissions.name: Photos (add only)
permissions.why: to save images you export from a PDF to your photo library. The app cannot read your library.

permissions.name: Face ID
permissions.why: to protect the app with App Lock, only if you turn it on. iOS performs the check.

permissions.name: Tracking (App Tracking Transparency)
permissions.why: to ask whether ads may use your advertising identifier. Saying no does not limit any feature.

your_controls: **Change your ad-privacy choices** in *Settings → Ads & Privacy → Privacy options* (shown in regions where the law requires it, such as the EEA, the UK and some US states).
**Stop tracking** in *iOS Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking*.
**Revoke Camera, Photos or Face ID access** in iOS Settings.
**Delete your files** in *History*, or delete the app to remove everything.

support_faq.a: No. Every PDF tool runs on your device. Your documents, their names and their contents are never sent to us or to anyone else. The only exception is **Web to PDF**, which loads the web page you enter from that website.

support_faq.q: Can the app remove a password I don't know?
support_faq.a: No. You need the current password to unlock a PDF. This protects documents that belong to someone else.

support_faq.q: Why do I see ads, and how do I remove them?
support_faq.a: Ads keep the app free. **Premium** removes them. You can also choose whether ads may be personalised: in the App Tracking Transparency prompt, or later in *iOS Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking*.

support_faq.q: How do I delete my data?
support_faq.a: Delete files in **History**, or delete the app. Your documents live only on your device, so this removes them completely.
